preset.read-only.label: Read-only
preset.read-only.description: Reading files and checking state go straight through; writes, commands and machine changes ask you first and only proceed once you allow that one
preset.workspace.label: Workspace write
preset.workspace.description: File changes inside the workspace are allowed; writes outside it and commands go through the approval card (the default)
preset.full-access.label: Full access
preset.full-access.description: Nothing is asked: edits anywhere and commands run directly (catastrophic commands are still refused)
preset.auto-review.label: AI review
preset.auto-review.description: Every call is shown to a model judge first: an allow goes through, a high-risk or unclear verdict falls back to your approval card
